description: Defines the IMedia interface and a template class Media implementing IMedia, including nested Handler class for source handling, with methods for media control and data transfer.

classes.name: IMedia
classes.description: Interface for media operations including remote ID retrieval, open, close, reset, write, and read functions.

classes.name: Media
classes.description: Template class implementing IMedia, managing media source, data transfer, and state handling with nested Handler class.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: Nested class within Media, derived from SOURCE, managing state change notifications and data send/receive operations.

methods.name: Reevaluate
methods.description: Signals the media to reevaluate its state after changes.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Copies data into the send buffer for transmission.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Copies received data into the receive buffer.
